## Change

Describe the concrete problem and the resulting behavior. Link an issue if relevant.

## Validation

List the commands run and their results. For package changes, confirm the fixture copies were refreshed with `npm run fixtures:install` before integration tests. Explain any checks that could not run.

## Compatibility and scope

Note changes to supported APIs, runtime behavior, dependency pins, or build profiles. Include documentation updates and remaining limitations where relevant. Local test results should not be described as full SDK or production certification.
